purpose: Section-level mapping from the supplied source to the curriculum. This is the artefact that makes 'which source supports this lesson' answerable, in both directions. Section identifiers, titles and printed pages are taken from knowledge/sources/mml/structure.json (generated); the concept lists and competency links are authored and reviewed.
how_to_maintain: When a source file changes, re-run tools/index_mml.py, then diff structure.json. Sections whose identifiers disappeared or moved must be re-reviewed here, and every lesson citing them becomes stale (see tools/build_coverage.py).

known_limits: The source's exercise sets carry no solutions in this draft. Using its exercises therefore means authoring our own worked solutions, which must be verified independently rather than presented as the authors' solutions.

Chapters 8-12 have no exercise sets in this draft (verified against the PDF; see knowledge/sources/mml/pdf-verification.json). Practice for those chapters must be authored or sourced elsewhere and labelled accordingly.

For 6.3, 6.4 and 7.10 the wording survives in mangled form; for 2.7, 5.7 and 7.9 no matching wording was found. Any use of those items must be checked against the PDF page before the item is quoted or adapted.

reconciliation.rule: The section map is the fine-grained view and the union of the two directions is treated as correct; this file records that the union was applied rather than asserting that a human reviewed each link.
